Six interactive figures for the story. Each URL below is one embed.

    One base, many departments

    Spatial data reaches the State Geoportal from departments across Chhattisgarh. The Revenue Department supplies the base: district, tehsil, block and village boundaries for the whole state. Every other department's data arrives on top of that base, each source in its own format and to its own schedule. Mining, Anganwadi and BharatNet are three of them. The work is to merge those submissions onto one set of boundaries and one coordinate system, so that a village means the same village in every layer. Today that merge holds 162 layers from 42 departments, published to one standard. Three applications already run on it: Mining, Anganwadi and BharatNet.

    This is the pipeline that brings them together, and the checks that keep what reaches the map dependable.starts at Intake
